mobile.home.connect.role: Primary disconnected Home action in the suggestion-row slot
mobile.home.connect.tone: Direct imperative; computer means the machine running Local Operator, not a new account
mobile.home.connect.length: One full-width row at phone sizes; preserve the existing touch target, do not invent a character cap
mobile.home.connect.note: Opens the saved-computer/tunnel picker. This is an action label, unlike the disabled composer's explanatory sentence.

mobile.home.connect_disabled.role: Disabled composer explanation when Home has no connected computer
mobile.home.connect_disabled.tone: Brief instruction explaining the prerequisite, not a network error or blame
mobile.home.connect_disabled.length: Short sentence below the composer; may wrap at narrow phone widths
mobile.home.connect_disabled.note: Shown only while disconnected, not when a connected draft is empty. Send means submit a prompt to the connected machine.

mobile.home.folders_failed.role: Warning banner after reading the connected computer's folders fails
mobile.home.folders_failed.tone: Temporary, recoverable failure; do not imply the folders were deleted
mobile.home.folders_failed.length: Banner body may wrap; a separate Retry action must remain reachable
mobile.home.folders_failed.note: Only shown while no usable home directory is available; clears after a successful reread. This is not a permission-to-delete message.

mobile.home.greeting.role: Home splash headline above suggestions before the first prompt
mobile.home.greeting.tone: Welcoming, plain question matching the desktop's English greeting
mobile.home.greeting.length: Title text centred in the available phone width; wrapping is allowed, no fixed cell budget
mobile.home.greeting.note: Not agent-generated conversation text. No name or personalisation placeholder. Suggestions below it are model-facing and outside this extraction.

mobile.home.start_refused.role: Local fallback body when starting a session fails without a relay explanation
mobile.home.start_refused.tone: Matter-of-fact refusal about a missing folder on the connected machine
mobile.home.start_refused.length: Alert body may wrap beneath the separately owned alert title
mobile.home.start_refused.note: Prefer the relay's own displayable message when available. No folder path placeholder: never interpolate an exception or infer that a real path was checked.

mobile.home.starting.role: Transient Home splash replacement while the first send is in flight
mobile.home.starting.tone: Neutral progress state, not success; preserve the ellipsis convention
mobile.home.starting.length: Exactly one explicit line, no newline; the composer must not move when the splash yields
mobile.home.starting.note: Describes starting a session, not merely sending a message to an existing session. No duration or count placeholder.
